Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE MEMBER OF THEMATALE MUNICIPAL COUNCILUNDER SECTION 65A(2) OF THELOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262) AS AMENDED BYLOCAL AUTHORITIES (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 30 OF 2013
WHEREAS the office of a member in Matale Municipal Council has fallen vacant by reason of not attending threeconsecutive meetings without permission;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the recognized political party namely United People’s Freedom Alliance, towhich the former member, Arachchige Thusith Roshan Mirisse belonged, was required by me under Section 65A(2) ofthe aforesaid Ordinance, to nominate within a period of thirty (30) days a person eligible under the Ordinance forelection as a member of that Matale Municipal Council who shall be declared elected as a member ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has nominated Mr. Etipola MapaGunathilaka Mudiyanselage Rohana Kumara being an eligible person under the aforesaid Ordinance to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE, I, Sudu Dewage Shanika Anuruddha Rupasinghe, Returning Officer of Matale MunicipalCouncil, acting in terms of Section 65A(2) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance as amended by filling of Vacanciesin Local authorities (Special Provisions) Act, No. 30 of 2013 (Chapter 262) do hereby declare Mr. Etipola Mapa GunathilakaMudiyanselage Rohana Kumara elected as a member of the Matale Municipal Council.
S. D. S. A. RUPASINGHE,Returning Officer,Matale Municipal Council.District Elections Office,Matale,18th December, 2015.
